models_evaluated: AI-ECG algorithm for low LVEF and atrial fibrillation

links.outcome: AI-ECG performance in liver transplant evaluation patients versus general population, and by QTc
links.effect: Performance in LT evaluation patients was similar to the general population but lower with prolonged QTc; AUROC 0.69 for post-transplant AF and 0.69 for later low LVEF.
links.quote: The performance of AI-ECG in patients undergoing LT evaluation is similar to that in a general population but was lower in the presence of prolonged QTc.

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating the prognostic and diagnostic performance of an existing AI-ECG algorithm in a specific clinical cohort (liver transplant candidates) to predict post-operative cardiac complications.
